decisions.reason: The pipe cleaning box builds on established fluid-handling fabrication, so it reflects real investment and fits the announced direction, and it is too new for weak results to count as anything but temporary.

Public waste bins are distant from the core business and carry the least sunk commitment, yet after only one year on the market and with public-sector buyers already served, management will likely give them more time rather than admit a misstep.
Ground sleeves for posts extend the firm's existing metal processing and form a visible product family that management has committed to publicly, so it will persist.

The cast iron variant is part of the ground sleeve line the firm has invested in and presented, and dropping it within a year would expose the launch decision, so it stays despite some overlap with the steel version.
Steel ground sleeves draw directly on the firm's core steel expertise and in-house surface treatment, which makes them central to its offer and very likely to be kept.
